addr: 1st Block, 783, 1st Cross Rd, HAL 2nd Stage, Doopanahalli, Indiranagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560008, India

rev.t: Decent place for a start-up. You get a homely atmosphere there. There is a person who brings beverages for you twice a day. Restrooms are neat and clean. However, it is cleaned only once a day I think. No food service provided. So 4 stars overall.

Beginest has a friendly environment for anyone who wants their own office space . The area surrounding Beginest is also friendly and away from the hustle and bustle of the main roads. I recommend this place to anyone who is looking for a good coworking space.
